name: io.github.soyrageagency/proxmox-mcp-server
description: Chat with your Proxmox VE cluster: list nodes, VMs and LXC containers, read status and storage, manage the guest lifecycle and take snapshots — with read-only and allowlist safety.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Proxmox VE API, e.g. https://192.168.1.10:8006

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_TOKEN_ID
environmentVariables.description: API token id in the form user@realm!tokenname, e.g. root@pam!mcp

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_TOKEN_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: API token secret (the UUID shown once when the token is created)

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_VERIFY_TLS
environmentVariables.description: Verify the TLS certificate. Most Proxmox installs use a self-signed cert, so this is usually false.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_MCP_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: Expose only read tools — no start/stop/reboot, no snapshot writes.
